practicals.title: PRIMARY ACTIVITIES
content: Keep project report of V semester course Project-I
innovative ideas , Project innovative ideas , Appreciate the
importance of course outcomes , Recheck and correct model or
drawing if required , Industrial visit or industrial survey , Work

practicals.title: PROJECT EXECUTION
content: Execute project preparation activities as per work allocation matrix
(Option of flexi time based work can also be practiced. For this
option, it may not be necessary to exactly follow the time table
slots. This can be on continuous base also along with time table

practicals.title: DRAFT PROJECT REPORT
content: Documentation of final project report which includes following in
Project title, Assembly and detail production drawings
List and specifications of machineries, equipment and tools
of material with make or buy decision, Specifications of bought out
Process sheets-As per format given in course Industrial
Details of inspection / testing carried out., Details
